sources.title: Surf-Forecast.com surf guide: Devil s Punch Beverly Beach

tide: Surfable at all stages of the tide. (surf-forecast)
notes: wannasurf pin 1.9 km from ours. surfnerd pin 0.0 km from ours. surf-forecast pin 1.7 km from ours (its coordinates are given to 0.01°). surfnerd gives no workable swell ("Unknown") and no break notes; its swell-exposure compass (SSW - NNW) is not a stated window for this break (it follows the facing), so no window is recorded. wannasurf lists a single good swell direction (West), too narrow for a window. surf-forecast: "exposed beach". surfnerd lists its workable wind as offshore from W, which is onshore for its own W facing (its wind-exposure compass agrees with the facing); this page is low-confidence.

tide: works at Mid (Best at Mid, Better on rising) (surfnerd)
